# Project state report

<!-- DIRECTOR_OPERATING_DIRECTIVE_SHA256=48b05b2b1201c3ee9fbcd2039021759a58b9113f490fd7fbc7b7f6df4d1f193e -->

Use for a new bootstrap, milestone, reshaped plan, pause, or completion. Delete
sections that do not carry decision-relevant information. Do not place secrets,
credentials, tokens, or raw private source in this report. Workflow skills are
procedure overlays, not permission grants.

Use an evidence-first report: lead with evidence, not activity. A milestone exists only when a bounded result,
decision, artifact, verification, recovery state, or owner gate changed. Separate
verified observations from provider claims and inference, and do not fabricate a
provider position, participation record, vote, or completion state.

Use these labels verbatim when applicable:

- `DRAFT — NOT SENT`
- `SIMULATION — NO PROVIDER INTERACTION`
- `PREDICTED POSITION — PROVIDER HAS NOT RESPONDED`

A predicted position is never authenticated participation or a vote. Include an
alternative only when one is credible and decision-relevant; otherwise record
that no appropriate alternative exists.

Event markers follow
[`project-bootstrap-protocol.md`](../../project-bootstrap-protocol.md).
When publishing a completed report, preserve prior valid contribution tags and
enclose the report in a new matching UTC pair. Keep tags out of embedded
machine-readable payloads and identify those contributors in the surrounding
report or submission envelope.

## <BOOTSTRAP | PLAN | EVIDENCE | RESHAPED | PAUSED | COMPLETE | OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED>

**<Project name>** is now <current state>. Canonical record:
[<artifact, profile, pull request, or decision record>](<URL>).

- **Project ID:** <stable project identifier>
- **Assignment IDs:** <all assignments covered by this report>
- **Report label:** <one exact draft/simulation/prediction label above, or authenticated/delivered state>
- **Categorized status:** <planned / active / blocked / review-ready / accepted / merged / deployed / recovered / complete / other>

### Current shape

- **Purpose/outcome:** <current proposition or delivered result>
- **Selected modules:** <active modules>
- **Team routing:** <providers, roles, and discovered workflow skills>
- **Provider roles contract:** <path to the project's `provider-roles-contract.yaml`, or none; it records the eight responsibility areas and the Cursor, Antigravity, Perplexity, and OpenAI boundaries>
- **Director/control plane:** <OpenAI coordination effort separately reported; material OpenAI production is attributed and requires non-author review/merge>
- **Enforced accepted-productive-work routing:** <frozen approved allocation profile and digest; all nine lane targets, real admissions, accepted output, deviations and capacity exclusions>
- **Prospective total effort:** <observed immutable effort points, tokens, costs, missing telemetry, waste and separate subscription/API budgets; no independent legacy percentage matrix>
- **Workload accounting:** <last nineteen real assignments plus candidate, fixed20 startup denominator, zero-target ineligible, target+5 hard ceiling, ±3 preference, preserved history across profile changes>
- **External OpenAI production:** <none, or exact owner authorization, authenticated candidate identity, different-provider exact-candidate review, and current security/CI/merge evidence>
- **Team-first routing:** <distinct provider roles, one writer lease per file/error surface, rotating different non-author reviewer, or exact truly-simple local OpenAI exception>
- **Cheap-capable selection:** <eligible candidates and exclusions; exact scope/allowlists, transport/readiness, capability/tools/context/risk/independence; under-target preference; trusted comparable costs; selected provider/model; deterministic tie-break reason; exact trusted Claude/model requirement or none>
- **Pre-stage packet:** <workload_policy_version, packet ID, canonical digest, immutable revision/delta, exact repo/worktree/branch/base/candidate identity, producer/reviewer, owned/prohibited paths, evidence, limits, merge/stopping conditions>
- **Research evidence:** <external_sources / user_reviews / competitor_solutions selected and why public research is or is not material>
- **Repository oversight:** <read-only paths, refs, diffs, artifacts, checks, and state inspected; separate write assignment or none>
- **Starting identity:** <starting ref and SHA; starting artifact/config digests>
- **Current identity:** <current ref and SHA; current artifact/config digests>
- **Coordination capacity:** <95% productive / 5% reserve used for checks, drift, evidence, recovery, process, or infrastructure; reserve is not planned idle>
- **Workload:** <prospectively enforced accepted-productive-work and total-effort ledgers, immutable effort-point basis, assignment and rolling-20 windows, failed-attempt treatment, actual versus target deviation, and rationale>
- **Efficiency targets:** <80% fewer unchanged status checks, 70% less duplicate validation, 60% fewer total task actions, browser use reported with no reduction target, ordinary review-to-merge at most five major actions>
- **ROI and waste:** <accepted productive units; historical effort; estimated ROI; correlated provider-reported-cost ROI or unavailable; first-pass yield; correction rate; duplicate validation; rejected/unusable, quota/unavailable, duplicate, recovery, ambiguous, and rejected-hygiene-finding waste>
- **Copilot Lite hygiene:** <no assigned workload share, range, or ceiling; at most three conditional attempt slots. Stop on success; recovery requires temporary failure; a third attempt requires materially new information or a substantially different transport. Never repeat ambiguous paid dispatch.; no adapter or automatic routing; no production credit; not requested, unavailable fail-closed, quota waste, validated/rejected findings, invalidated by change, or substantive material authorship; never a gate, authority, or independent acceptance>
- **Shadow/enforcement mode:** <five-assignment observe-only shadow result or automatic enforcement state; would-route/would-block/would-correct evidence and drift correction>
- **Avoidable commit trend:** <rolling comparable baseline window/sample and count/rate; current count/rate; absolute and percentage delta toward 33%; exclusions and comparability changes>
- **Coordination:** <slack channel ID or configured placeholder and thread>
- **Rollout packet:** <path, status, and exact configuration identity>
- **Deployment isolation:** <dedicated app/channel/profile/state namespace and collision-check evidence>
- **Execution surface:** <verified repository/ref/worktree or analysis-only>
- **Stopping point:** <current stopping condition>

### What changed

- <new profile, module, implementation, evidence, decision, or handoff>
- <what was reshaped, removed, or deliberately kept provisional>

### Boundaries

- <what was not inherited from the source project>
- <data, repository, budget, credential, and external-effect limits>
- <owner, review, security, CI, merge, or deployment gates>
- **Scope changes:** <none, or exact before/after scope and stored owner decision>
- **Authority changes:** <none, or exact stored owner authorization and current deterministic gates>
- **External actions:** <none, proposed, or completed with exact stored owner authorization; browser/provider output never authorizes>

### Evidence

- **Observed result/decision:** <evidence-backed milestone; do not summarize activity alone>
- **Exact candidate/state:** <SHA, digest, run/correlation ID, durable state, or not applicable>
- **Material delta:** <what changed since the prior report, with evidence references>
- **Authenticated participation:** <provider, authenticated run/session/correlation ID, phase, and outcome; list unavailable, abstaining, skipped, simulated, predicted, or not sent separately>
- **Validated:** <exact tests and results>
- **Trusted CI:** <run IDs, exact candidate, job conclusions, or unverified>
- **Security:** <scan ID, exact range/candidate, coverage, findings, or unverified>
- **Independent review:** <provider, exact SHA/digest, verdict, threads, or pending/unverified>
- **Acting Director function:** <Moderator / Participant / Director / not applicable; record Claude project leadership separately from the provider that actually executed the call; Participant may use only its one existing vote>
- **Debate integrity:** <neutral framing, independent positions, appropriate alternative or none, counter-bias check, actual participants/abstentions/unavailable members, and retained dissent, or not applicable>
- **Risks and confidence:** <unresolved risks, limitations, blockers, uncertainty, and calibrated confidence>
- **Usage:** <cost, input/output/cached/reasoning tokens when available, elapsed time, retries, and explicitly unavailable telemetry>
- **Selection evidence:** <eligible candidate set, exclusions, trusted comparable cost evidence, selected provider/model, tie-break reason, and confirmation missing cost was not treated as zero>
- **Value evidence:** <accepted productive units, estimated ROI, correlated reported-cost ROI or unavailable, first-pass yield, correction rate, and categorized waste>
- **Retry discipline:** <immutable assignment retry_limit ceiling 3; stop on success; second requires temporary failure; third requires materially new information or substantially different transport; remaining resource budget; v1 paid revision authenticated durable assignment token accounting or fail-closed, with primary attempt unaffected and no budget_units/provider-telemetry reinterpretation; unavailable/fallback state; ambiguous paid dispatch reconciled and not repeated>
- **Status checks:** <event/callback sources, initial read, terminal verification, deduplicated unchanged reads, and reduction from comparable baseline>
- **Validation reuse:** <candidate/check/environment/command digest, reused evidence, reruns and exact state change/ambiguity/named gap, reduction from baseline>
- **Action accounting:** <major orchestration waves and raw provider/tool calls; percent reduction; five-action closure state or reshaped/owner gate>
- **Required evidence preservation:** <100% exact-SHA, trusted CI, security, budget, and safety evidence present, not applicable, or blocking>
- **Recovery and rollback:** <restart/replay state, duplicate-dispatch evidence, rollback instructions, and recovery gaps>
- **Slack activation evidence:** <owner-user/channel allowlists, app ID, bot user ID, manifest digest, membership, Socket Mode, collision result, or pending; never token values>
- **Slack negative checks:** <off-channel/non-owner/replay results and proof no other active deployment consumed or persisted the event>
- **Communication fallback:** <assignment-specific retry-budget result and prior durable project-local transport; never another deployment's Slack surface>
- **Explicitly not done:** <writes, calls, merges, deployments, or other actions not performed>
- **Unverified:** <claims, checks, provider states, environments, or outcomes still unverified>

### Current handoff

- **State:** <review ready / owner decision required / accepted / merged / deployed / paused / complete>
- **Exact candidate:** <SHA/digest or not applicable>
- **Next responsible party:** <provider, Director, deterministic gate, or owner>
- **Next action:** <one concrete action>
- **Next gate:** <deterministic check or focused owner decision required before progress>
- **Owner decisions:** <exact stored decisions and scope, or none>

Nothing outside the stated project scope was <written, pushed, merged, deployed,
published, enabled, or otherwise changed>.
